title: 第7章 拿得起放得下第8章 极境
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;“辰南哥哥，恭喜你了！”
昭告圣地完毕，金色法旨重新落下，被姜玉婵递给辰南。
她对待其他人，清冷如仙，但在辰南面前，却是展颜一笑，如邻家小妹。
这一抹笑容落在林轻眉眼中，却是让她心中刺痛加深。
“多谢圣女！”
辰南缓缓的松了口气，双手接过金色法旨。
“辰南哥哥，你跟我还见外吗？”
姜玉婵眨了眨眼。
辰南微微一怔。
辰父与圣主乃是生死之交，因此辰南和姜玉婵也是青梅竹马。
但辰南无法修炼，自觉配不上姜玉婵，逐渐疏离。
后来辰南与林轻眉结为道侣，更是彻底避见姜玉婵。
没想到最后来接自己离开的，居然是她。
“小婵！”
辰南微微吸了口气，喊出了许久未曾说过的昵称。
姜玉婵脸上的笑容更加明艳，就像是一朵盛开的鲜花。
“恭喜辰南哥哥脱离苦海，重获新生。”
“如今彩礼拿回，我们还是赶紧离开这个晦气之地吧！”
姜玉婵主动挽上辰南的手臂，刺痛了林轻眉的眼。
辰南点点头，看都没看林轻眉一眼，和姜玉婵一起离开了玉灵峰。
“呸！什么东西，不过是巴结圣女的小白脸罢了。”
“姐，你真是慧眼识人，看出了姓辰的不是好东西，我看呐，他肯定早就和玉婵圣女勾搭上了，这样一个不忠不义的混蛋，早走早省心。”
等辰南和姜玉婵离开后，林子衿这才骂骂咧咧。
在她看来，肯定是辰南巴结姜玉婵在先，她们才是受害者。
林轻眉心头复杂，一时间不知道该说什么好。
“轻眉，你也别太难过，今日之事是他们咄咄逼人在先，不过你放心，我一定会替你报仇的。”
“十天之后的开脉大典，我绝不会让他顺心如意。”
“另外还有一个月后的诸脉演武，他虽然重开了辰家一脉，但若扛不住诸脉演武的挑战，辰家一脉也将彻底灭亡！”
萧天麟这一次被逼下跪，简直是奇耻大辱。
就算不为了林轻眉，他也绝不会放过辰南，必定要狠狠报复。

read2(); "Brother Chennan, congratulations!"
After announcing the Holy Land, the golden decree fell again and was handed to Chen Nan by Jiang Yuchan.
She treated other people as coldly as a fairy, but in front of Chen Nan, she smiled like the girl next door.
This smile falling in Lin Qingmei's eyes made the pain in her heart deepen.
"Thank you Saint!"
Chen Nan slowly breathed a sigh of relief and took the golden decree with both hands.
"Brother Chennan, do you still want to see me outside?"
Jiang Yuchan blinked.
Chen Nan was slightly startled.
Chen's father and the Holy Lord are close friends of life and death, so Chen Nan and Jiang Yuchan are also childhood sweethearts.
But Chen Nan was unable to practice and felt that he was not worthy of Jiang Yuchan, so he gradually became alienated.
Later, Chen Nan and Lin Qingmei became Taoist couples, and they completely avoided seeing Jiang Yuchan.
Unexpectedly, she was the one who came to pick him up in the end.
"Xiaochan!"
Chen Nan took a slight breath and called out the nickname he hadn't said for a long time.
The smile on Jiang Yuchan's face became even brighter, like a blooming flower.
"Congratulations to Brother Chen Nan for escaping from the sea of suffering and regaining a new life."
"Now that the bride price is back, let's leave this unlucky place as soon as possible!"
Jiang Yuchan took the initiative to hold Chen Nan's arm, which stung Lin Qingmei's eyes.
"Okay!"
Chen Nan nodded and left Yuling Peak with Jiang Yuchan without even looking at Lin Qingmei.
"Bah! What the hell, he's just a pretty boy trying to fawn over the saint."
"Sister, you are really smart and discerning. You can see that the person named Chen is not a good guy. I think he must have hooked up with Saint Yuchan a long time ago. Such an unfaithful and unjust bastard, it would be easier to leave early."
After Chen Nan and Jiang Yuchan left, Lin Zijin cursed.
In her opinion, it must be Chen Nan who fawned over Jiang Yuchan first, and they are the victims.
Lin Qing's eyebrows were complicated and she didn't know what to say for a moment.
"Qingmei, don't be too sad. What happened today was caused by their aggressiveness, but don't worry, I will definitely avenge you."
"I will never let him go as he wishes during the pulse opening ceremony in ten days."
"In addition, there will be Zhumai Martial Arts in one month. Although he has reopened the Chen family lineage, if he cannot withstand the challenge of Zhumai Martial Arts, the Chen family lineage will also be completely destroyed!"
Xiao Tianlin was forced to kneel down this time, which was a great shame and humiliation.
Even if it wasn't for Lin Qingmei, he would never let Chen Nan go and would definitely take revenge.
